QuestInfo.name: We are all part of the Maple family
QuestInfo.0: In celebration of MapleStory's 5th Anniversary, you can receive a free Family Studio Photo Coupon from the Maple Admininstrator. Try taking a photo with all your friends.
QuestInfo.1: Obtain a photo coupon that will transport you and your friends to the Family Studio.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained a Family Studio Photo Coupon which can be used to take a 5th Anniversary commemorative photo with your friends.
QuestInfo.summary: Take a photo with your friends to commemorate MapleStory's 5th Anniversary.

0.0: MapleStory has just reached its 5th Anniversary. Thank you so much for your love and support these past 5 years!
0.1: To celebrate our 5th Anniversary, Family Studio is distributing free photos. We would like to give you a free #bFamily Studio Photo Coupon#k #h0#. Would you like to accept?

yes.0: If you come see me again, I will give you a #bFamily Studio Photo Coupon#k. Many prizes have been prepared for those with great photos and stories to share. For details, please visit our official website (maplestory.nexon.net).

no.0: Please see me anytime you and your friends want to take photos.

1.0: You can enter Family Studio by opening your Item Inventory and double-clicking on #bFamily Studio Photo Coupon#k. Take a picture with your friends and share the photo along with your interesting story at the Events page.
